title: Higher-order epistasis drives evolutionary unpredictability toward new antibiotic resistance
description: Analysis code and processed data for a combinatorially complete TEM-1 beta-lactamase fitness landscape (55,296 variants from 18 clinical mutations across 13 residues) measured under native (ampicillin) and non-native (aztreonam) antibiotic selection. Includes preprocessing, epistasis-order decomposition, LightGBM/SHAP regression, graph analysis, direct coupling analysis / latent generative landscapes, and figure generation. Accompanies the Nature Communications article.
